intro.heading: Show that your photos are really you
intro.body: Look into your camera for a few seconds and make two small head turns. We compare you with the photos on your profile, and your profile then shows “Photos confirmed as you”.
intro.point1: The camera picture is checked on your phone or computer and discarded the moment the check ends. Mangalya never receives it.
intro.point2: We keep whether the check passed and the date. No picture, no face data, no score.
intro.point3: Withdraw your consent at any time on this screen. The confirmation is removed straight away.
intro.consent: I agree that Mangalya may compare a live picture of my face with my own profile photos, only to confirm that the photos are me. The picture is discarded after the check, and I can withdraw this consent at any time.
intro.tips: Find soft, even light, take off sunglasses, and keep only your face in the frame.

camera.videoLabel: Your camera, shown like a mirror

denied.title: Camera permission is off
denied.body: Allow camera access for Mangalya in your browser’s site settings, then try again.

unavailable.title: No camera found
unavailable.body: This check needs a camera. Try on your phone, or on a computer with a webcam.

loadFailed.title: The check could not start
loadFailed.body: Something went wrong while preparing the check. Please try again.

step.left: Slowly turn your head to your left
step.right: Slowly turn your head to your right
step.capture: Look straight at the camera and hold still
step.noFace: We can’t see your face. Move into the frame.
step.many: Only you should be in the frame

passed.title: Photos confirmed as you
passed.body: Your profile now shows this, with the month you did it. Nothing from the camera was kept.

noMatch.title: We couldn’t confirm it this time
noMatch.body: This happens in dim light, at an angle, or when a photo is old. Face a window or a lamp, look straight at the camera, and try again.

liveness.title: The head turns weren’t seen
liveness.body: Turn your head slowly, a little further each way, and keep your face in the frame.

noFace.title: We couldn’t see one clear face
noFace.body: Make sure only you are in the frame, in good light, and try again.

noFaceInPhotos.title: Your main photo needs a clear face
noFaceInPhotos.body: Choose a main photo that shows your face clearly, then try again.

failed.help: Still not working? Write to Mangalya support and a person will look at it.

noPhotos.title: Add a photo of yourself first
noPhotos.body: The check compares you with the photos on your own profile, and your profile has no photo yet.

noProfile.title: Add a photo of yourself first
noProfile.body: The photo check compares you with the photo on your own Mangalya profile. Add a clear photo of yourself on My profile, then come back.

rateLimited.title: Let’s try again tomorrow
rateLimited.body: You have tried several times today. Please come back tomorrow, in good light.

verified.until: Valid until {{date}}. Adding a new photo asks you to confirm again.
verified.withdrawConfirm: This removes the confirmation from your profile. Withdraw?
verified.withdrawn: Consent withdrawn. The confirmation has been removed.

card.title: Confirm your photos are you
card.hint: A one-minute camera check. Nothing from the camera is kept.

gate.title: A quick check that it is you
gate.body: You are setting up a profile for someone else, so Mangalya first confirms you are a real person. Take a selfie in your camera; it takes about a minute and the picture is not kept. After that you continue straight to your son or daughter’s profile.

error.network: Couldn’t reach Mangalya. Check your connection and try again.

addSelf.title: First, a clear photo of you
addSelf.body: Anyone who makes a profile for someone else is checked to be a real person. Take a selfie or pick a clear photo of your face; then a one-minute camera check confirms it is you.
